lead: House of Taga is a reading site. We collect as little as we can.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: Nothing, unless you write to us. If you use the contact form, post a comment or email us, we keep your name, email address and message so we can reply or publish your comment. Your email is never shown.

sections.heading: Analytics
sections.body: We count visits in aggregate to understand which stories are read. This data is not tied to your name or used to profile you.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: The site uses only the cookies it needs to work and to measure visits. You can block them in your browser; every story stays readable.

sections.heading: Sharing
sections.body: We do not sell or rent your information. When you use a share button, the service you share to handles your data under its own policy.

sections.heading: Keeping and deleting
sections.body: Messages are kept only as long as a conversation needs. Email us and we will delete what we hold about you, including a published comment.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.body: If this policy changes, the date above changes with it.
